vocabulary.doc: Each district is a single connected piece in the adjacency graph the plan supplies. The theory has no geometry: a plan that misstates which precincts touch can prove contiguity of a map that is not contiguous.
No district departs from the ideal population by more than the stated share. Compared by cross-multiplication, so no rounding enters a legal threshold.
Wasted votes are those cast for a losing party plus a winner’s votes above half. The gap is the difference over total votes. Positive means party A wastes more, that is, party A is disadvantaged.
vocabulary.phrase: the efficiency gap is at most

vocabulary.doc: A county wholly inside one district is split zero times.
vocabulary.phrase: no county is split more than

vocabulary.doc: Quantifies over every uniform swing in the band, so it cannot be settled by evaluation. Between seat changes the gap moves at twice the swing, so this clause is satisfiable only by maps whose seats respond to opinion.
vocabulary.phrase: the efficiency gap stays within … under every uniform swing of at most …

requirements.title: Fair Districting Act § 2 — Districting Standards

clauses.name: wellFormed
clauses.description: The plan’s assignment, adjacency and tallies are structurally sound.

clauses.name: contiguity
clauses.description: Every district is a single connected piece.

clauses.name: populationDeviation
clauses.description: No district departs from the ideal population by more than 0.50%.

clauses.name: efficiencyGap
clauses.description: The efficiency gap of the reference election is within 7.00%.

clauses.name: countySplits
clauses.description: No county is divided among more than two districts.

requirements.statement:
requirement section2 titled "Fair Districting Act § 2 — Districting Standards"
    for plan P where
  · the plan is well formed
  · every district is contiguous
  · population deviation is at most 0.50%
  · the efficiency gap is at most 7.00%
  · no county is split more than 1 time

requirements.title: Fair Districting Act § 5 — Durability of Fairness

clauses.name: wellFormed
clauses.description: The plan’s assignment, adjacency and tallies are structurally sound.

clauses.name: swingRobustness
clauses.description: For every uniform swing within five points, the efficiency gap stays within 7.00%. Quantifies over an unbounded range, so evaluation can refute it but only a proof can establish it.

requirements.statement:
requirement section5 titled "Fair Districting Act § 5 — Durability of Fairness"
    for plan P where
  · the plan is well formed
  · the efficiency gap stays within 7.00% under every uniform swing of at most 5.00%
